segments.name: Community banking services
products: residential and commercial real estate loans
regular and term savings accounts and savings certificates
Individual Retirement Accounts and Keogh plans
segments.description: Provides consumer and commercial community banking services, including loans, deposits, brokerage, insurance, and trust and wealth management, to communities in Kentucky, West Virginia, and Tennessee.
segments.evidence: Management analyzes the operation of CTBI assuming one reportable segment, community banking services.

revenueModel.text: CTBI earns interest on loans and securities and fees from customers for banking, brokerage, trust, and wealth management services, with most customer contracts short-term and paid when services are performed.
revenueModel.evidence: Generally, CTBI enters into contracts with customers that are short-term in nature where the performance obligations are fulfilled and payment is processed at the same time.
